name: Settsu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Settsu city emblem in navy: a stylised swirl of two curved strokes, like a wave.
history: Municipal flag of Settsu, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 13 October 1966.

features.role: Settsu city emblem — a stylised swirl of two curved strokes, like a wave
